name: ate_propose
description: Validate an intended trade against on-chain policy and strategy limits without sending a transaction. Returns a proposalId valid for 120 seconds. The rationale is stored verbatim and its hash is emitted on-chain when executed.

candidateId.description: Autonomous mode: the ate_candidates_get entry this proposal acts on (side must match; amountIn ≤ maxAmountIn; unexpired). Omit only with origin=discretionary

thesis.description: Required iff origin=discretionary: why this trade, what would prove it wrong, exit plan

signalId.description: Paid signal that informed this trade, if any (G-HSP)
